items.claim: Albert Einstein won the 1921 Nobel Prize in Physics for his theory of general relativity.
items.key_finding: Einstein's 1921 Nobel Prize honored the photoelectric effect.
items.executive_summary: Einstein's 1921 Nobel was awarded for the photoelectric effect, not relativity.
items.suggested_revision: Einstein's 1921 Nobel Prize in Physics was awarded for his discovery of the law of the photoelectric effect.

items.claim: Water boils at 100°C at sea level.
items.key_finding: Water boils at 100°C at standard atmospheric pressure.
items.executive_summary: At standard atmospheric pressure, water boils at exactly 100°C.
